title_en: Every minute counts. 46th Infantry Division, a network of partners is being trained to respond to disasters.
summary_en: On November 7, 2569 at 09.30 – 16.00 hours, the Special Task Force of the 46th Ranger Corps conducted a disaster relief and emergency preparedness check-up as well as Unit School training for its troops at the ranger battalion at 4610 Golden Sand Temple and Sai Buri River in Rueso Village, Rueso District, Narathiwat Province.
